description:
Court notebook. This page contains a record of divorce and a trousseau list from Cairo in the 1180s. Each of the two columns was written by a different scribe and is a separate record. 

I (recto, right column and bottom of verso): see separate record. 

II (recto, left column and most of verso): Dowry evaluation (taqwīm) for [...] b. Yeḥezqel ha-Kohen and the orphan Sitt al-Maʿālī bt. Yeshuʿa b. Peraḥya. Dowry: 55 dinars. Marriage payments: 5 + 25 = 30. The bride receives half a house in partnership with her infant brother Bū Manṣūr. Her mother is Sitt al-Fakhr [this note may actually apply to record I instead of record II]. Lines 1-5 were written by Shelomo b. Zakkay.

(Information from Goitein's index card and from Amir Ashur's dissertation)
